newsitem.title: UK: MBO buyout team posts bid for William Cook.
newsitem.headline: MBO buyout team posts bid for William Cook.

text.p: A management buyout team spearheaded by tough-talking executive chairman Andrew Cook launched its offer document for steel castings firm William Cook Plc on Tuesday, confirming its desire to beat back a hostile takeover bid by engineering group Triplex Lloyd Plc.
Steel Castings Investments Plc, backed by venture capital institution Electra Fleming, confirmed it was offering 425 pence per share for William Cook, valuing it at about 80 million stg.
This offer compares with Triplex Lloyd's latest offer worth 383.4 pence per share in cash or somewhat less than 400p in the form of a share-only deal.
Introducing the document, Steel Castings' chairman Lawrence Banks said the firm believed its recommended offer represented the best available value to Cook shareholders.

"I therefore urge shareholders to accept immediately. We are encouraged by the reception of our offer from William Cook shareholders, customers and employees and are confident that this offer will prove successful," he added.
Steel Castings' backers on Tuesday made available comments of support from leading customers in the defence and mechanical engineering sector who are supplied by William Cook.
This unusual move appeared aimed at challenging the main plank of Triplex Lloyd's prolonged assault on the company, which has focused on Andrew Cook's performance record.
Triplex had accused Cook, and what it called his "established and continuing approach to management", of being the reason William Cook shares had historically traded at a low price earnings multiple.

For their part, the MBO's backers have said they place great significance on the "most impressive" record of Cook and his team, a spokesman told Reuters, adding that the premium price being offered over Triplex Lloyd's bid reflected this regard, as well as the support the team has generated among customers.

One of the supplied references quoted Colin Clark, chief executive of Vickers Defence Systems, a unit of Vickers Plc, as saying he viewed "with great concern" a takeover of William Cook by Triplex Lloyd.

"Alternative suppliers are available for the products William Cook presently supplies. We see no reason to look elsewhere whilst the status quo prevails, but could do so if the need arose," he was quoted as saying.
